name: Saori Ojou-sama no Kutsujoku
source:
When I was in school, I (the protagonist) was bullied by a rich girl named Saori, who humiliated me so badly I dropped out.

A few years later, I abducted her, imprisoned her and r*ped her.
"It's not over yet. This is my revenge."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE169349.html]DLsite English[/url]]
